groups.sentence: Instructors may allow or encourage students to use AI for brainstorming and idea generation.
Students may use generative AI to brainstorm and generate ideas for their work.
Students may use AI to brainstorm topics, narrow and refine research questions, and do initial research.
Students may use AI for brainstorming only, and the final work must be their own.
AI can help students brainstorm and generate ideas.
Students may use AI to explore alternative approaches, options, and examples, including for prototyping and coding problems.
Students may use AI for brainstorming only if their instructor allows or approves it.
Students may use AI to surface counterarguments, opposing views, and blind spots in their thinking.
Students must not use AI for brainstorming.
